description:
A Beautiful and Feature-rich Music & Video Player with YouTube Support, Built in Flutter

Namida is a music and video player with a modern, customizable UI and a rich feature set:
local library indexing with tag editing, lyrics (embedded/LRC/online), waveform seekbar, playlists, folders view, and detailed listening history and statistics.
It also includes a built-in YouTube client (playback, downloads, subscriptions, comments, history) and connects to self-hosted media servers (Subsonic/Navidrome, Jellyfin, WebDAV, SMB).
it's jellyfish season! jellys from all across the deep oceans are approaching namida, is it an invasion?! or a targeted attack by commander @Tsuune? don't worry, a protective shield keeps them away.. unless you invite them from settings -> theme -> jelly icon. take a look at them beautiful jellys, but careful not to keep them there for too long ^^
✨ Highlights:
- Cross device sync: keep your library, history, playlists & settings in sync between devices.
- Stats & Your Year: charts about your listening habits and a year-in-review page, shareable in a tap - plus a slider in most played to hop between time ranges, and a button on each listen to open its range.
- Smart playlists: playlists built from rules that keep themselves up to date, with the same power available in search.
- Subtitles & captions for videos, and a big lyrics upgrade - a new provider, subtitle formats (srt/ssa/ass/sbv), a floating lyrics window on desktop & a simple single-line view.
- Better player: widescreen layout, lock button, long press shortcuts on the buttons (2x speed, restart, rewind, fast forward) and smoother track switching animations.
- Import your data: history from spotify & listenbrainz, playlists from jellyfin/subsonic servers.
- Brand new tagger: reading and writing tags is much faster and far more reliable, and the tags editor now suggests existing values as you type.
- Much faster everywhere: indexing, library loading, search and general ui.
- Smarter search: typo tolerant, with much better ranking, a refreshed search page and optional recent searches.
- YouTube: crossfade & gapless now work in the yt section, sign in with multiple profiles under one account, search filters everywhere (videos, local & hosted playlists, and by date inside a channel), parallel downloads, and comment notifications.
- Shuffle is now a proper toggle, independent from repeat modes.
- Desktop & linux: equalizer & loudness enhancer, working animations, shortcuts fixes, plus appimage, flatpak, winget and a windows portable build.
- Also: customizable home screen widget, ui scaling on small screens, per-item audio config, moods/tags/rating pages, copy/move track files, and a lot more.
